findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 is not fully covered: packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:140 records candidate-trial outcome rows and packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:162 records matched-control rows directly, but the smoke never invokes playbook_promotion_status to prove the required status reporting path. The current status handler only builds pendingLearning from outcome aggregates at packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1093 and does not expose/verify matched-control reporting, so the evidence note overclaims promotion status coverage.

Command registration coverage is missing for the new B-5f5b command surfaces: the new smokes call core builders directly (packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-seed-backfill-smoke.ts:181 and packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-trial-automation-smoke.ts:140,206) instead of dispatching playbook_seed_backfill/playbook_trial_run/playbook_promotion_timer through CLI or createMainRegistry. The existing registration smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-seed-promotion-loop-smoke.ts:1449 lists earlier playbook commands but omits playbook_seed_backfill, playbook_trial_run, and playbook_promotion_timer, so validation does not prove MAIN_TOOLS/registry/COMMAND_POLICIES/PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS wiring for these new commands.

packages/main/src/handlers/playbook.ts:1077 MEDIUM: playbook_promotion_status builds its payload from outcome/decision/seed/runtime data but never reads the new matched-control ledger or renders trial/control counts, so CHK-002 happy path claim that promotion status reports concrete trial exposure and matched-control rows is not satisfied; only playbook_trial_run reports those counts.
